features:
Key Features:

Coconut‑Pecan Flavor: Sweet, tropical coconut paired with crunchy pecan bits in a creamy base.

Ready-to-Use: No mixing—just open the tub, stir, and spread.

Gluten‑Free: Suitable for those avoiding gluten.

Pantry-Stable: Can stay on the shelf until opened; refrigerate after opening and use within 30 days.

Good Coverage: One tub is enough to frost a 13×9″ cake or around 30 cupcakes.

Benefits:

Effortless Decorating: Quick and ideal for busy bakers or last-minute desserts.

Flavor & Texture: Offers a crowd‑pleasing coconut‑pecan combination with satisfying crunch.

Kid & Crowd-Friendly: Soft and mild sweetness makes it a hit at gatherings and celebrations.

Consistent Performance: Smooth texture and reliable spreadability every time.
ingredients: Sugar, Water, Palm Oil, Coconut, Dextrose, Corn Syrup, Pecan Pieces. Contains 2% or less of: Modified Tapioca Starch, Salt, Propylene Glycol, Ethoxylated Mono and Diglycerides, Pectin, Color (yellow 5, blue 1, red 40, and other color added), Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Sodium Alginate, Calcium Chloride, Citric Acid, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Soy Flour, Egg Yolk. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Metabisulfite and Sodium Benzoate.
